title: NVMe Recovery — Pre-determined Reboot Solution

samsung_4tb.disease: PCIe link training failure — root port alive but NVMe controller cannot handshake
possible_causes: PCIe Gen speed mismatch (slot set to Gen5, drive is Gen4)
M.2 slot power rail not enabled in BIOS

wd_black_4tb.disease: Root port NULL — firmware has disabled the PCIe root port entirely
possible_causes: AMD CBS PCIe root port disabled
Slot shares lanes with PCIEX16_2 (bifurcation conflict)

bios_checklist: 1. Advanced → Onboard Devices → M.2 slots: ALL set to ENABLED (not Auto/Disabled)
2. Advanced → Onboard Devices → M.2_2 slot: ENABLED
3. Advanced → Onboard Devices → M.2_3 slot: ENABLED
4. Advanced → AMD CBS → NBIO → PCIe Configuration → All root ports: ENABLED
5. Advanced → AMD CBS → NBIO → PCIe Gen Speed: Auto or Gen4 (NOT forced Gen5)
8. Advanced → AMD CBS → NBIO → IOMMU: ENABLED (or Auto)
9. Advanced → AMD CBS → CCD Control → CCD0+CCD1 both ENABLED (fixes CPU 8→16 cores)
10. Advanced → AMD CBS → Core Count → All cores enabled
11. Advanced → AMD CBS → SMT: ENABLED (fixes 16→32 threads)

sourdough_cycle.reboot: Enter BIOS → apply checklist → save & exit
